name: report

select.description: Which read to run. A field marked [select: ...] applies only to the selects named.

rootId.description: Only this project root (depth 0): a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. Default every root you may see.

since.description: Window start, inclusive: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset. Default until minus 7 days.

until.description: Window end, exclusive: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset. Default now. At most 31 days after since (waste: 7).

groupBy.description: Row grouping, default tool. usage accepts tool, operation, host, surface, principalKind, errorCode, day (UTC date), principal (admin only). [select: usage]

cursor.description: The page.next value of the previous page. [select: usage]

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Aggregate reports over the call log. select: usage (calls, errors, bytes, tokens, latency, retries and replays per group); waste (ratios: redundant reads, over-fetch, reads with no later write, empty next, related follow-through, lifecycle-free rejections). Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
